- `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` (`memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, create, s.MarkdownService)`) — runs on every new memo.

- `Tags` — all `#tag` occurrences, deduplicated preserving case.
- `Property.Title` — text of an H1 heading if it's the first block in the document.

- `Property.HasCode` — true if any code block/fenced code block/code span exists.
- `Property.HasTaskList` — true if any task checkbox exists.
